children: Cardinal Infrastructure Group, through subsidiary Cardinal Civil Contracting, entered into a second amendment to its Credit Agreement to expand borrowing capacity. The amendment establishes a delayed draw term loan facility of up to $250 million and increases the revolving commitments from $75 million to $100 million with Truist as administrative agent and a syndicate of lenders. The changes are expected to enhance liquidity and provide flexibility to fund projects and growth initiatives.
